# VariatCopy - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: VariatCopy
- Tagline: Two angles for every product, ready to test.
- Domain: https://variatcopy.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Generate two contrasting copy angles for the same product - e.g. discount-led vs quality-led - each with a hook, body, and CTA, plus a one-line test hypothesis.
- Two contrasting angles
- Hook + body per variant
- CTA variants
- One-line test hypothesis

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 5 variant sets/mo
- **Pro** — $19/mo — Unlimited, save history
- Checkout: https://variatcopy.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://variatcopy.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Do I need to install anything?
A1. No. VariatCopy runs in your browser.
Q2. Is my input kept private?
A2. We use it only to generate your result and minimize retention. See Security.
Q3. Does it guarantee compliance / correctness?
A3. No. It is decision-support; you own the final call. See the honesty note in Security.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON and CSV.
Q5. Is there an API?
A5. Yes, the web form is backed by a REST endpoint you can call from your pipeline.
